series.name: Multi V VRF CH codes (partial, PK-relevant commercial only)
series.notes: Ample Air LG CH fault codes (technician KB, medium). Multi V VRF commercial line — only 3 CH codes evidenced; rest of VRF out of PK residential scope (quarantined). Separate file from split sheets.

title.en: Indoor unit not registered / not initialised on bus
title.ur: Indoor unit bus par registered/initialised nahi

meaning.en: Indoor unit is not connected or not initialised with the outdoor unit on the communication bus.
meaning.ur: Indoor unit communication bus par outdoor unit ke sath connected ya initialised nahi hai

causes.ur: Naya IDU bina addressing/commissioning ke laga

causes.en: Loose bus wiring or wrong address dip/rotary switch
causes.ur: Bus wiring loose ya address dip/rotary switch galat
Andar ka IDU PCB bijli par nahi hai

solutions.en: Power cycle; verify address settings and bus connections
solutions.ur: Power cycle dein, phir address settings aur bus ke connections check karein

source.title: Ample Air LG CH fault codes

notes.en: Not present on Universal or official consumer Guide; medium confidence.
notes.ur: Yeh Universal ya official consumer Guide mein nahi hai, is liye medium confidence rakha gaya hai.

meaning.en: Low-pressure sensor is not reading properly.
meaning.ur: Low-pressure sensor theek se reading nahi de raha.

causes.ur: LP sensor khula/short ya disconnect ho gaya

causes.en: Sensor hose blocked or at wrong process port
causes.ur: Sensor hose band ho ya galat process port par lage ho
ODU PCB tak ki wiring kharab hai

solutions.ur: Service book karwayein — technician ki diagnosis zaroori hai

solutions.en: Reseat/test LP sensor against pressure; replace if bad
solutions.ur: LP sensor ko dobara lagayein aur pressure ke against test karein; kharab ho to badal dein

source.title: Ample Air LG CH fault codes

notes.ur: Yeh CH24 ke switch latch se alag hai.

meaning.en: High-pressure sensor is not reading properly.
meaning.ur: High-pressure sensor sahi tarah reading nahi de raha.

causes.ur: Bahar ke PCB tak ki wiring mein fault

solutions.ur: Fauran service book karwayein, technician ki diagnosis zaroori hai
HP sensor test karein ya badlein, phir wiring check karein
Pressure protection ko kabhi bypass na karein

source.title: Ample Air LG CH fault codes

notes.ur: Yeh CH24 wale switch latch se alag hai.
